mapper.select: SELECT event_type AS eventType, command_sha256 AS commandSha256, task_id AS taskId, item_id AS itemId FROM lbl_task_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lbl_task_event(event_id, tenant_id, task_id, item_id, event_type, idempotency_key, command_sha256, payload_sha256, payload_json, actor_user_id, correlation_id, occurred_at) VALUES(#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{itemId}, #{eventType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{commandSha256}, #{payloadSha256}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON), #{actorUserId}, #{correlationId}, #{occurredAt})

INSERT INTO lbl_task_exception(exception_id, tenant_id, task_id, item_id, exception_code, reason, resolution_type, actor_user_id, correlation_id, occurred_at) VALUES(#{exceptionId}, #{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{itemId}, #{exceptionCode}, #{reason}, #{resolutionType}, #{actorUserId}, #{correlationId}, #{occurredAt})
